246K likes, 34 comments - gal_gadot on August 29, 2026: "Thursday night we finally got to celebrate The Runner 💙

This film pushed me in every possible way emotionally and physically and I couldn’t have done it without the incredible crew beside me. Long days running through the streets of London in every kind of weather and a team that gave everything to bring this story to life.

So proud of what we made and so grateful to everyone who was part of it.

The Runner is almost yours 💙 September 2nd on @primevideo
